query:
SELECT JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'orgs', (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM orgs
            ),
            'caches', (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM caches
            ),
            'paths', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(path_count), 0)
                FROM caches
            ),
            'storedBytes', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size), 0)
                FROM caches
            ),
            'physicalStoredBytes', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0)
                FROM blob_objects
            ),
            'pendingBytes', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0)
                FROM upload_sessions
                WHERE status = 'finalizing'
                    OR (status IN ('pending', 'uploading', 'streaming') AND expires_at > NOW())
            ),
            'uploadsPending', (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM upload_sessions
                WHERE status = 'finalizing'
                    OR (status IN ('pending', 'uploading', 'streaming') AND expires_at > NOW())
            ),
            'servedThisMonth', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bytes), 0)
                FROM bandwidth_daily
                WHERE day >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            ),
            'publicServedThisMonth', (
                SELECT COALESCE(SUM(public_bytes), 0)
                FROM bandwidth_daily
                WHERE day >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
            ),
            'activeTokens', (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM api_tokens
                WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
                    AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
            ),
            'apiKeys', (
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM org_api_keys
                WHERE revoked_at IS NULL
            )
        )::text AS "overview!"
